email.subject1: a signal play for Bluebeam Max
email.body1:
Benjamin, saw Bluebeam Max just hit global availability with its AI-powered reviews and automation.

A new premium tier usually opens more in-market construction accounts than a team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Benjamin, quick follow-up on the Bluebeam motion.

With a premium tier to push, pipeline expectations tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings you need to drive Bluebeam Max adoption, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Benjamin, last bit of proof on this.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other construction-tech sellers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Benjamin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you ramp Bluebeam Max, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and a new launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it either way.
